document: Mist Trail in Yosemite National Park. The Mist Trail climbs alongside the Merced River to Vernal Fall and Nevada Fall, with steep granite steps and heavy spray in spring. Difficulty: hard. Length: 6.4 miles. Elevation gain: 2185 ft. Route: out-and-back. Features: waterfall, views, river.

Alamere Falls Trail in Point Reyes National Seashore. Alamere Falls is a coastal waterfall route in Point Reyes with rolling terrain, bluff views, and beach access near Wildcat Camp. Difficulty: moderate. Length: 8.4 miles. Elevation gain: 1601 ft. Route: out-and-back. Features: waterfall, coastal, wildflowers.

Eagle Lake Trail in Desolation Wilderness. Eagle Lake Trail in Desolation Wilderness is a moderate out-and-back route of about 2.0 miles with 459 ft of climbing, featuring lake, views, forest. Difficulty: moderate. Length: 2.0 miles. Elevation gain: 459 ft. Route: out-and-back. Features: lake, views, forest.
